name: Customer insights researcher
summary: Finds out what customers need and how they talk, from interviews, surveys, reviews and social mentions. Turns it into words and fixes the business can use.

changelog.note: First release: interview recruiting, incentives and consent under the MRS, ICC/ESOMAR and Insights Association codes, GDPR and UK GDPR (with the Data (Use and Access) Act 2025), US recording and privacy basics, synthesis (reflexive thematic analysis, affinity mapping), review and mention mining within FTC, CMA, Google and Trustpilot rules, focus groups, diaries and taste tests, with 29 checked sources.
Named the UK regulator as the Information Commission, which replaced the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) on 30 Sep 2026 and still uses the ICO name.
